page_title: EVE 2-0 CHE | Everton v Chelsea 10/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Half-chance! Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) plays a pass into the box, but Jordan Pickford reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90+2' 2 - 0 A rebound that flew far from the goal landed at the feet of Lewis Dobbin (Everton) and he perfectly dispatched the ball into the bottom left corner.
90+2' James Garner (Everton) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
89' Chelsea quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
89' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Chelsea will have a chance to score from a corner.
86' Sean Dyche has decided to substitute Jack Harrison and he is replaced by Lewis Dobbin (Everton).
86' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) makes a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
86' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
84' It's time for a substitution. Ian Maatsen (Chelsea) comes on in place of Marc Cucurella.
84' Mauricio Pochettino is forced to make a change. Robert Sanchez is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Djordje Petrovic (Chelsea).
83' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) commits a foul and Michael Oliver immediately signals a free kick.
82' The referee awards a corner and Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) goes over to take it.
81' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Chelsea comes to nothing.
81' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Chelsea earn a corner.
80' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
77' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
75' The attendance is 39280.
75' Beto (Everton) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Robert Sanchez has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
73' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) picks up a caution.
72' Axel Disasi (Chelsea) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
68' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
67' Substitution. Dominic Calvert-Lewin leaves the pitch and is replaced by Beto (Everton).
67' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to make a change. Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) replaces Armando Broja.
66' The substitution is prepared. Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Enzo Fernandez.
66' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
66' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) inside the box following a slide rule pass.

60' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a decent low strike towards the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford denies him with a great save.
59' Yellow card. Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge. Chelsea win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
57' Referee Michael Oliver signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Everton players have a reason to celebrate!
55' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Everton players aren’t happy.
54' Goal! Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.
54' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Robert Sanchez.
53' Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) is able to continue to play.
51' Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
50' A rebound bounces out to Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
50' A corner kick by Everton is thwarted by the well prepared Robert Sanchez (Chelsea).

50' Dwight McNeil (Everton) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save. The referee blows his whistle, Everton are awarded a corner kick.
49' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) hits a shot towards the right side of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Jordan Pickford.
48' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
47' Jack Harrison (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
47' A pass by Dwight McNeil (Everton) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
46' Sean Dyche makes a half-time substitution. Amadou Onana (Everton) comes on in place of Idrissa Gueye.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Michael Oliver has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' A cross from Nathan Patterson (Everton) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
45+4' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
45+4' Dwight McNeil (Everton) sends the corner into the box, but Robert Sanchez intercepts it and averts the threat.
45+3' Dwight McNeil (Everton) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
45+3' The resulting corner from James Garner (Everton) is cleared.
45+1' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
45+1' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
43' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

43' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Chelsea.
42' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
41' Ashley Young (Everton) is being substituted because of an injury. Sean Dyche sends Nathan Patterson on the pitch.
41' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) controls a great pass from Armando Broja on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar.
40' Flag goes up against Dwight McNeil (Everton) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

38' Jordan Pickford doesn't have to worry about this one. Mykhailo Mudryk plays a pass into the feet of Armando Broja (Chelsea), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the left post.
38' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
34' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
31' The game is interrupted now, Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' Michael Oliver has a clear sight and sees a foul from Dwight McNeil (Everton).
28' Chelsea take a short corner kick.

28' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
27' Problems for Mauricio Pochettino as Reece James (Chelsea) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Levi Colwill replaces him.
26' Jack Harrison (Everton) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Michael Oliver blows for a foul.
25' Jack Harrison (Everton) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Robert Sanchez scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post.
25' Dwight McNeil (Everton) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
24' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
22' The corner from Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) is cleared away by the defence.
22' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Chelsea force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
19' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
19' Robert Sanchez displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
18' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
17' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
15' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Idrissa Gueye (Everton) for his blatant foul. Idrissa Gueye (Everton) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
14' A dangerous attempt from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) was aimed to the top left corner, but Jordan Pickford pulls off a superb save and stops this one.
14' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) takes a short corner kick.
14' Armando Broja (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman points to the corner flag, Chelsea are going to take it.
12' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
11' Armando Broja (Chelsea) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Michael Oliver who sees an offensive foul.
10' The resulting free kick from Dwight McNeil (Everton) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
10' Michael Oliver blows for a foul after Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. There is a free kick near the sideline to Everton.
9' Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
9' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) prepares to take a corner kick.
9' An attempted cross from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is cleared. Chelsea get a corner.
8' A pass from Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) is intercepted by Robert Sanchez and the move breaks down.
7' Jack Harrison (Everton) tries to find Dominic Calvert-Lewin, but he puts too much power on the pass.
6' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
3' Armando Broja (Chelsea) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
2' The ball is cleared after Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' Ashley Young (Everton) sends a long cross over to Abdoulaye Doucoure, but Robert Sanchez comes forward to gather the ball.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Everton will have the kick-off.
Michael Oliver is the one to supervise the game today.
